docs: 抵押借贷市场的 Anchor 指令入口。
Anchor instruction entry points for the GGBOY collateralized lending market.

instructions.name: borrow
docs: 在价格、抵押率和池流动性约束下发放借款并增加未偿本金。
Lend debt tokens within price, LTV, and pool liquidity limits and increase outstanding principal.
`context` 绑定借款仓位、资金池、市场价格和借款人的收款账户。
`context` binds the position, cash pool, market price, and borrower's destination.
`amount_raw` 是大于零的借款 Mint 最小单位数。
`amount_raw` is a positive amount in debt mint base units.

accounts.name: borrower
docs: 借款人签名，首笔借款时出资创建市场借款总账 PDA。
Signing borrower pays the rent exemption for the market debt ledger on its first loan.

accounts.name: market
docs: 市场及其绑定的借款 Mint、抵押 Mint 和现金托管地址。
Market with its bound debt mint, collateral mint, and cash custody address.

accounts.name: debt_mint
docs: 借款资产 Mint，按其精度执行代币转账。
Debt asset mint. Transfers check its decimal precision.

accounts.name: collateral_mint
docs: 抵押资产 Mint，提供抵押余额和价格的换算精度。
Collateral mint, supplying the scale for valuing locked collateral.

accounts.name: cash_vault
docs: 现金从市场自己的规范 PDA 托管账户转出。
Loan cash comes from the market's canonical custody account.

accounts.name: destination
docs: 本次款项到账的签名借款人代币账户。
Debt token account belonging to the borrower that receives the loan.

accounts.name: supply_pool
docs: 已记账的出借资产限制市场能发放的借款总额。
Recorded supplied assets limit the total principal this market may lend.

accounts.name: borrow_market
docs: 单独的市场本金总账，首次借款创建。
Separate market principal ledger, initialized by the first successful loan.

accounts.name: borrow_position
docs: 先前建立的个人仓位。只有指定钱包可以借款。
The existing position. Only the recorded borrower may borrow against it.

accounts.name: mock_collateral_price
docs: 市场管理员发布的规范价格账户，执行时仍须核对时效。
Canonical price published by the market administrator, checked again for freshness at execution.

accounts.name: token_program
docs: 用于支付借款资产的经典 SPL Token 程序。
Classic SPL Token program for paying out debt assets.

accounts.name: system_program
docs: 首笔借款时创建总账用的 System Program。
System Program used to allocate the ledger on the first loan.

instructions.name: deposit_collateral
docs: 将抵押品转入托管，首次操作创建签名钱包的独立仓位。
Transfer collateral into custody and create the signing wallet's position on first deposit.
`context` 绑定签名钱包、其来源账户和市场托管。
`context` binds the signing wallet, its source account, and market custody.
`amount_raw` 是大于零的抵押 Mint 最小单位数。
`amount_raw` is a positive amount in collateral mint base units.

accounts.name: borrower
docs: 既授权本人代币转账，也为新抵押仓位提供免租金余额的签名人。
Signer authorizing a transfer from their token account and funding the new position's rent reserve.

accounts.name: market
docs: 规范市场 PDA，将指令绑定到已配置的抵押 Mint 和托管账户。
Canonical market PDA binding the instruction to its configured collateral mint and custody.

accounts.name: collateral_mint
docs: 市场登记的经典 SPL 抵押 Mint，提供真实转账精度。
Registered classic SPL collateral mint supplying the actual transfer precision.

accounts.name: collateral_vault
docs: 市场 PDA 控制的抵押托管账户，与借款现金隔离。
Collateral custody under market PDA authority, separate from borrowing cash.

accounts.name: source
docs: 签名借款人持有的同 Mint 代币来源，用实际最小单位余额支付。
Matching-mint token source owned by the signing borrower and debited in base units.

accounts.name: borrow_position
docs: 按市场和借款人派生的抵押债务仓位，首笔存入时创建。
Collateral and debt position derived from market and borrower, created on first deposit.

accounts.name: token_program
docs: 核对 Mint 精度并执行转账的经典 SPL Token 程序。
Classic SPL Token program checking mint precision and executing the transfer.

accounts.name: system_program
docs: 分配首次抵押仓位时调用的系统程序。
System Program called to allocate a first collateral position.

instructions.name: enable_interest
docs: 在未偿旧债务归零后，由市场管理员启用固定点计息。
The administrator enables fixed-point interest after outstanding legacy debt reaches zero.

accounts.name: administrator
docs: 签名管理员为池账本增加免租余额。 The signing administrator funds the larger ledger's rent exemption.

accounts.name: market
docs: 绑定已登记管理员和现金托管的规范市场。 Canonical market binding its administrator and cash custody.

accounts.name: supply_pool
docs: 已初始化的池账本保留原有余额和份额，扩充数据用于计息。
The initialized supply pool keeps its assets and shares and expands to store interest accounting.

accounts.name: borrow_market
docs: Canonical debt ledger PDA. It can be absent before a loan. The handler validates any initialized ledger and requires zero outstanding debt.

accounts.name: cash_vault
docs: 已绑定市场和借款 Mint 的现金托管账户。 Canonical cash custody for the market and its debt mint.

accounts.name: system_program
docs: 调整账本数据大小时支付用于免租差额。 Used to fund the rent difference for the larger ledger.

instructions.name: initialize_lending_market
docs: 由程序升级权限持有人创建市场及两种资产的独立托管账户。
Create the market and separate custody accounts for both assets as the current program upgrade authority.
`context` 提供管理员签名、两枚已初始化的 Mint 和待创建的三个 PDA。
`context` supplies the administrator signature, two initialized mints, and the three new PDAs.
初始化将两类托管权绑定市场 PDA。任何账户约束失败都会回滚整个指令。
Initialization assigns both custody authorities to the market PDA. Any constraint failure reverts the whole instruction.

accounts.name: administrator
docs: 持有程序升级权限的签名人，支付三个账户的免租金余额，单位为 lamports。
Upgrade authority signer who pays the rent-exempt balance of the three accounts in lamports.

accounts.name: lending_program
docs: Anchor 核对当前部署的借贷程序地址及可执行状态。
Anchor checks the address and executable flag of the current lending program.

accounts.name: program_data
docs: 校验升级权限属于当前借贷程序，防止借用其他程序的 ProgramData。
Bind upgrade authority to this deployment by rejecting another program's ProgramData.

accounts.name: debt_mint
docs: 管理员选择的经典 SPL mockUSDC Mint，通过公钥和精度绑定。
Classic SPL mockUSDC mint selected by the administrator. Its address and precision identify it.

accounts.name: collateral_mint
docs: 管理员选择的经典 SPL tSOL Mint。独立于借款资产，精度沿用 Mint。
Classic SPL tSOL mint selected by the administrator. Its address differs from the debt mint and its precision is read from the mint.

accounts.name: market
docs: 单次创建的市场状态，同时作为两个托管账户的代币操作权限。
One-time market state creation. The same PDA authorizes token operations for both custody accounts.

accounts.name: cash_vault
docs: 新建的空资金池，只托管绑定的 mockUSDC，转出必须使用市场 PDA 授权。
New empty cash custody holding only the bound mockUSDC. Outflows require the market PDA's authority.

accounts.name: collateral_vault
docs: 新建的空抵押托管，只托管绑定的 tSOL，转出必须使用市场 PDA 授权。
New empty collateral custody holding only the bound tSOL. Outflows require the market PDA's authority.

accounts.name: token_program
docs: 初始化两个代币托管账户的经典 SPL Token 程序。
Classic SPL Token program initializing both custody accounts.

accounts.name: system_program
docs: 为市场和两个托管账户分配链上空间和免租金余额的系统程序。
System program allocating space and rent-exempt balances for the market and both custody accounts.

instructions.name: liquidate
docs: 清算人代付超出清算阈值仓位的债务并获得抵押品，无法回收的债务冲减出借池资产。
Repay a position beyond the liquidation threshold and seize collateral. Write unrecoverable debt off against pool assets.
两项参数是各自资产最小单位。双零仅用于无法覆盖一最小单位代偿的坏账。
Both arguments use their respective asset base units. Two zeros are accepted only for debt with no repayable unit.

accounts.name: liquidator
docs: 承担代偿并接收抵押品的签名人，须与仓位借款人不同。
Signer funding the repayment and receiving collateral, distinct from the borrower.

accounts.name: market
docs: 规范市场及其绑定的两种 Mint 和两个托管账户。
Canonical market binding both mints and both custody accounts.

accounts.name: debt_mint
docs: 用于代偿的借款 Mint，转账核对其小数精度。
Debt mint used for repayment, with decimals checked during transfer.

accounts.name: collateral_mint
docs: 用于领取的抵押 Mint，其小数精度也用于清算报价。
Collateral mint paid out, with decimals also used for the liquidation quote.

accounts.name: cash_vault
docs: 市场 PDA 控制的独立借款现金托管。
Separate debt-token cash custody under market PDA authority.

accounts.name: collateral_vault
docs: 市场 PDA 控制的独立抵押托管。
Separate collateral custody under market PDA authority.

accounts.name: liquidator_debt
docs: 签名人持有的借款 Mint 关联账户，支付实际代偿额。
Signer's debt mint ATA paying the actual repayment.

accounts.name: liquidator_collateral
docs: 签名人持有的抵押 Mint 关联账户，接收实际扣划的数量。
Signer's collateral mint ATA receiving the actual seized amount.

accounts.name: supply_pool
docs: 规范出借池，坏账冲减其记账资产，不修改已登记的份额。
Canonical supply pool whose recorded assets absorb bad debt without changing shares.

accounts.name: borrow_market
docs: 规范市场借款总账，代偿与坏账共同减少未偿债务。
Canonical debt ledger reduced by repayment and write-off.

accounts.name: borrow_position
docs: 使用仓位内已验证的借款人和所属市场检查规范 PDA，无需借款人签名。
Canonical PDA derived from its stored borrower and verified market, without a borrower signature.

accounts.name: mock_collateral_price
docs: 市场自己的规范测试价格，处理函数还校验发布时间。
Canonical test price for the same market, with publication time checked by the handler.

accounts.name: token_program
docs: 执行两条代币转账的原版 SPL Token 程序。
Classic SPL Token program executing both token transfers.

instructions.name: ping
docs: 验证脚手架指令可以调用，返回成功且不读写链上账户。
Confirm the scaffold instruction is callable and return success without accessing on-chain accounts.
`_context` 是 Anchor 传入的指令上下文，本指令无需读取其中的数据。
`_context` is the Anchor instruction context. This instruction does not read it.

instructions.name: prepare_supply
docs: 准备借贷池和签名出借人的仓位，由独立付款人承担首次创建费用。
Prepare the lending pool and signing supplier's position using a separate rent payer.
`context` 识别市场、签名出借人与付款人。已有份额和记账余额不变，无代币转账。
`context` identifies the market, signing supplier, and payer. Existing shares and accounting balances are preserved without moving tokens.

accounts.name: payer
docs: 为尚不存在的 PDA 支付免租金余额的签名账户。
Signing account that funds the rent-exempt balance for missing PDAs.

accounts.name: supplier
docs: 拥有出借份额的签名账户，可以由调用程序为自己的 PDA 签名。
Signing owner of supply shares, including a PDA signed for by the calling program.

accounts.name: market
docs: 本程序部署已初始化的规范市场 PDA。
Initialized canonical market PDA of this program deployment.

accounts.name: supply_pool
docs: 市场的份额总账；存在时沿用原资产值和总份额。
Market-wide supply ledger. Preserve the asset value and total shares when it exists.

accounts.name: supply_position
docs: 归属于签名出借人与市场的份额仓位；存在时沿用已有份额。
Position owned by the signing supplier in this market. Preserve any existing shares.

accounts.name: system_program
docs: 为未建立的 PDA 分配账户空间并转入免租金余额。
Allocates space and transfers rent-exempt balances to missing PDAs.

instructions.name: repay
docs: 从借款人转回借款资产并减少该仓位与市场的未偿本金。
Transfer debt tokens back from the borrower and reduce position and market principal.
`context` 绑定签名人、其仓位和市场的借款资产账户。
`context` binds the signer, their position, and the market's debt token account.
`amount_raw` 是大于零且不超过本金的借款 Mint 最小单位数。
`amount_raw` is positive debt mint base units at or below the outstanding principal.

accounts.name: borrower
docs: 付款并减少自己未偿本金的签名钱包。
Wallet paying to reduce its own outstanding principal.

accounts.name: market
docs: 市场状态，绑定借款资产和托管账户。
Market state binding the debt mint and custody.

accounts.name: debt_mint
docs: 转回资金池的借款资产 Mint。
Debt asset mint returned to the pool.

accounts.name: cash_vault
docs: 由市场 PDA 授权的规范现金托管账户。
Canonical cash custody controlled by the market PDA.

accounts.name: source
docs: 签名借款人用于付款的独立代币账户。
Separate debt token account used by the signing borrower to pay.

accounts.name: borrow_market
docs: 本金偿还后同步减少的市场总账。
Market ledger reduced by the repayment amount.

accounts.name: borrow_position
docs: 记有签名人目前未偿本金的个人借款仓位。
Signing borrower's existing position with outstanding principal.

accounts.name: token_program
docs: 转回借款资产所用的经典 SPL Token 程序。
Classic SPL Token program used to return the debt assets.

instructions.name: set_mock_collateral_price
docs: 发布管理员提供的市场测试价格，发布时间使用链上时钟。
Publish an administrator-supplied test price using the on-chain clock.
`context` 绑定市场管理员和规范预言机 PDA。
`context` binds the market administrator and canonical oracle PDA.
`price_raw` 是 1 整单位抵押品对应的借款 Mint 最小单位数，必须为正。
`price_raw` is positive debt mint base units per whole collateral token.

accounts.name: administrator
docs: 市场登记的管理员，首次发布时支付价格 PDA 的免租金余额。
Market administrator, who funds the rent-exempt price PDA at first publication.

accounts.name: market
docs: 通过规范 PDA 和管理员签名将测试价格限定在当前市场。
Bind the mock price to this market through its canonical PDA and administrator signature.

accounts.name: mock_collateral_price
docs: 当前市场唯一的报价 PDA，初次发布时创建。
Canonical quote PDA for this market, created upon first publication.

accounts.name: system_program
docs: 创建价格账户时调用的系统程序。
System Program used to allocate the quote account.

instructions.name: supply
docs: 将出借者的 mockUSDC 转入市场托管账户，按最低到账份额限制记录仓位。
Transfer the supplier's mockUSDC into market custody and credit shares subject to the minimum output.
`context` 包含签名出借人、对应的市场和代币账户。
`context` supplies the signing supplier and matching market and token accounts.
`assets_in` 与 `min_shares_out` 分别是资产与份额的最小单位，均使用六位精度且必须为正。
`assets_in` and `min_shares_out` are positive six-decimal asset and share base units respectively.
转账、份额更新和事件在同一笔交易生效，失败时一同回滚。
The transfer, share updates, and event take effect together or revert on failure.

accounts.name: supplier
docs: 出借资金的签名人，首次创建池记账或个人仓位时支付免租金余额。
Funds the supply and pays the rent-exempt balance when pool accounting or the wallet position is created.

accounts.name: market
docs: 原始 169 字节市场状态，约束本次出借使用的 Mint 和托管地址。
Original 169-byte market state that binds the mint and cash custody for this supply.

accounts.name: debt_mint
docs: 市场登记的六位小数借款资产 Mint，用于 TransferChecked 校验。
Registered six-decimal debt mint, used for TransferChecked validation.

accounts.name: cash_vault
docs: 资金转入市场绑定的规范托管账户，代币权限属于市场 PDA。
Deposit funds into the market's canonical custody under its PDA authority.

accounts.name: source
docs: 出借人实际持有的借款资产账户。地址必须和托管账户不同。
Debt token account owned by the supplier. It must differ from cash custody.

accounts.name: supply_pool
docs: 每个市场独立的出借记账。不存在时由首笔成功的出借创建。
Supply accounting for this market, created by its first successful supply when absent.

accounts.name: supply_position
docs: 记录该签名钱包在当前市场的份额，不与其他钱包共用。
Records the signing wallet's shares in this market independently from other wallets.

accounts.name: token_program
docs: 执行有精度校验的经典 SPL Token 转账。
Classic SPL Token program for decimal-checked transfers.

accounts.name: system_program
docs: 首次出借时分配记账与个人仓位 PDA。
Allocates the accounting and wallet position PDAs on first supply.

instructions.name: withdraw_collateral
docs: 在剩余抵押品覆盖未偿本金的前提下取回抵押资产。
Release collateral while keeping enough locked collateral to cover any outstanding principal.
`context` 绑定签名人、仓位和托管，存有债务时还需有效价格。
`context` binds the signer, position, and custody. An active debt also requires a valid price.
`amount_raw` 是大于零的抵押 Mint 最小单位数。
`amount_raw` is a positive amount in collateral mint base units.

accounts.name: borrower
docs: 授权减少本人仓位并持有收款账户的签名借款人。
Signing borrower authorizing the decrease in their position and owning the destination.

accounts.name: market
docs: 规范市场 PDA，既绑定抵押账户，也用于授权托管转出。
Canonical market PDA that binds collateral accounts and authorizes custody outflows.

accounts.name: collateral_mint
docs: 市场登记的抵押 Mint，用于额度运算和精度校验转账。
Registered collateral mint used for limit arithmetic and decimal-checked transfers.

accounts.name: collateral_vault
docs: 市场持有的规范抵押托管，实际最小单位余额须覆盖请求。
Canonical market-owned collateral custody whose base-unit balance must cover the request.

accounts.name: destination
docs: 同 Mint 且由借款人持有的代币收款账户。
Matching-mint destination token account owned by the borrower.

accounts.name: borrow_position
docs: 已存在的抵押仓位，核对规范 PDA 与存储的市场和借款人身份。
Existing collateral position with its canonical PDA and stored market and borrower verified.

accounts.name: mock_collateral_price
docs: Always bind the canonical mock price PDA. When debt remains, the handler validates ownership, layout, market, and freshness.

accounts.name: token_program
docs: 负责精度校验和托管转出的经典 SPL Token 程序。
Classic SPL Token program for decimal checks and custody transfers.

instructions.name: withdraw_supply
docs: 用签名人的出借份额换回借款代币，受已记账现金和实际托管余额约束。
Redeem the signer's supply shares for debt tokens within accounted and actual custody cash limits.
`context` 绑定市场、出借仓位和签名人的收款账户。两项输入均须为正。
`context` binds the market, supply position, and signer's destination. Both inputs must be positive.
`shares_raw` 使用出借份额最小单位，`min_amount_out_raw` 使用借款代币最小单位。
`shares_raw` is in share base units and `min_amount_out_raw` is in debt token base units.
转账、份额扣减与实际结果事件同时生效。
The transfer, share debits, and result event take effect together.

accounts.name: supplier
docs: 持有出借份额、授权本次提取并接收代币的签名钱包。
Signing wallet that owns the shares, authorizes withdrawal, and receives the tokens.

accounts.name: market
docs: 绑定借款 Mint 和现金托管，并在转账时为托管签名的规范市场 PDA。
Canonical market PDA binding the debt mint and cash custody and signing the transfer.

accounts.name: debt_mint
docs: 市场绑定的六位小数借款 Mint，提供转账精度。
Market-bound six-decimal debt mint providing the transfer precision.

accounts.name: cash_vault
docs: 本次支付的规范托管账户，钱包不能直接授权处分其现金。
Canonical custody paying this withdrawal, controlled by the market rather than the wallet.

accounts.name: destination
docs: 签名人持有的同 Mint 收款账户，与资金池托管地址分离。
Matching-mint token account owned by the signer and distinct from pool custody.

accounts.name: supply_pool
docs: 记录本市场已记账资产和总出借份额的规范池账本。
Canonical pool ledger of accounted assets and total supply shares for this market.

accounts.name: supply_position
docs: 已有签名人仓位，核对种子与已存的市场及出借人身份。
Existing supplier position verified against its seeds and stored market and supplier.

accounts.name: borrow_market
docs: Pass the canonical debt ledger PDA. The handler recognizes an uninitialized account and otherwise verifies program ownership, layout, and market.

accounts.name: token_program
docs: 核对 Mint 精度并执行托管出账的经典 SPL Token 程序。
Classic SPL Token program for decimal-checked custody payouts.

errors.name: InvalidProgramData
errors.msg: ProgramData does not match the lending program

errors.name: UnauthorizedAdministrator
errors.msg: Only the program upgrade authority can initialize the lending market

errors.name: InvalidDebtMintDecimals
errors.msg: The debt mint must have six decimals

errors.name: IdenticalAssetMints
errors.msg: Debt and collateral mints must differ

errors.name: UnsupportedNativeMint
errors.msg: The wrapped native SOL mint is unsupported

errors.name: InvalidSupplyAmount

types.name: BorrowMarket
docs: 独立的市场借款总账，首次借款创建，沿用原市场和出借池的账户布局。
Separate market debt ledger created by the first borrow, preserving existing market and supply layouts.

fields.name: market
docs: 此借款总账所属的市场公钥。
Public key of the market that owns this borrowing ledger.

fields.name: total_debt_raw
docs: 全市场仍欠的本金，以六位小数借款 Mint 最小单位记录。
Outstanding principal across the market, in base units of the six-decimal debt mint.

types.name: BorrowPosition
docs: 一个钱包在此借贷市场的抵押品余额和未偿本金。
Locked collateral and outstanding principal for one wallet in this market.

fields.name: market
docs: 此仓位所属的市场公钥。
Public key of the market that owns this position.

fields.name: borrower
docs: 可以操作仓位的签名钱包。
Wallet authorized to sign operations against this position.

fields.name: collateral_raw
docs: 已锁定的抵押品，按抵押 Mint 最小单位记录。
Locked collateral in collateral mint base units.

fields.name: debt_raw
docs: 当前未偿还的本金，按六位小数借款 Mint 最小单位记录。
Outstanding principal in base units of the six-decimal debt mint.

types.name: LendingBorrowAction
docs: 已生效的借款仓位操作与操作后的余额，供回执及历史读取。
Executed borrowing action and resulting balances for receipts and history.

fields.name: market
docs: 本次操作的市场状态公钥。
Market state public key for this action.

fields.name: borrower
docs: 签名借款人公钥。
Public key of the signing borrower.

fields.name: kind
docs: 0 追加抵押品，1 借款，2 还款，3 取回抵押品。
0 deposits collateral, 1 borrows, 2 repays, and 3 withdraws collateral.

fields.name: amount_raw
docs: 实际转移的抵押或借款资产最小单位数，由 kind 决定使用的 Mint。
Base units of assets actually transferred, with the mint determined by kind.

fields.name: collateral_raw
docs: 操作后已锁定的抵押 Mint 最小单位数。
Collateral mint base units locked after this action.

fields.name: debt_raw
docs: 操作后剩余的借款 Mint 本金最小单位数。
Outstanding principal in debt mint base units after this action.

types.name: LendingLiquidation
docs: 清算或坏账结算成功后产生的实际变动，供索引和回执读取。
Settled liquidation or write-off amounts for indexing and receipts.

fields.name: market
docs: 结算所在借贷市场公钥。 Lending market public key.

fields.name: borrower
docs: 被清算的借款人公钥。 Borrower whose position was liquidated.

fields.name: liquidator
docs: 发起清算的签名钱包公钥。 Signing liquidator's public key.

fields.name: debt_mint
docs: 代偿资产 Mint 公钥。 Repayment asset mint.

fields.name: collateral_mint
docs: 扣划资产 Mint 公钥。 Seized collateral mint.

fields.name: repaid_raw
docs: 清算人实际代偿额，按借款 Mint 最小单位计。 Actual repayment in debt mint base units.

fields.name: seized_collateral_raw
docs: 清算人实际收取量，按抵押 Mint 最小单位计。 Actual seizure in collateral mint base units.

fields.name: bad_debt_raw
docs: 已冲减出借池的坏账，按借款 Mint 最小单位计。 Written-off debt in debt mint base units.

types.name: LendingMarket
docs: 保存市场管理员、代币 Mint 绑定和两个托管账户的公钥。
Stores the market administrator, token mint bindings, and both custody account addresses.

fields.name: administrator
docs: 初始化时持有程序升级权限的管理员公钥。
Public key of the administrator holding program upgrade authority at initialization.

fields.name: debt_mint
docs: 借款资金池使用的六位小数 mockUSDC Mint 公钥。
Public key of the six-decimal mockUSDC mint used by the cash pool.

fields.name: collateral_mint
docs: 抵押资产的 Mint 公钥，金额按该 Mint 自身的精度解析。
Collateral mint public key. Collateral amounts use this mint's decimal precision.

fields.name: cash_vault
docs: 与借款 Mint 绑定、由市场 PDA 授权的 SPL 资金池公钥。
SPL cash custody public key bound to the debt mint and controlled by the market PDA.

fields.name: collateral_vault
docs: 与抵押 Mint 绑定、由市场 PDA 授权的 SPL 抵押托管公钥。
SPL collateral custody public key bound to the collateral mint and controlled by the market PDA.

fields.name: bump
docs: Anchor 派生的规范 bump，供后续市场 PDA 签名使用。
Canonical bump derived by Anchor for future market PDA signing.

types.name: LendingSupply
docs: 一笔已执行出借的资产与份额变化，供链上历史与后续索引读取。
Asset and share changes of an executed supply, for transaction history and future indexing.

fields.name: market
docs: 市场状态 PDA 公钥。
Public key of the market state PDA.

fields.name: supplier
docs: 出借人的签名公钥。
Public key of the signing supplier.

fields.name: debt_mint
docs: 资金池使用的借款资产 Mint 公钥。
Public key of the debt asset mint used by the pool.

fields.name: assets_in
docs: 已转入资金池的六位精度借款资产最小单位数。
Base units of the six-decimal debt asset transferred into custody.

fields.name: shares_out
docs: 记入出借仓位的六位精度份额最小单位数。
Base units of six-decimal shares credited to the supply position.

types.name: LendingSupplyWithdrawal
docs: 提取成功后发出的份额与现金变动，供交易回执和活动索引使用。
Successful share and cash changes used by transaction receipts and activity indexing.

fields.name: market
docs: 本次提取所属的市场 PDA 公钥。
Public key of the market PDA for this withdrawal.

fields.name: supplier
docs: 签名出借者的公钥。
Public key of the signing supplier.

fields.name: debt_mint
docs: 实际支付的借款资产的 SPL Mint 公钥。
SPL mint public key of the debt asset paid out.

fields.name: shares_burned_raw
docs: 本次扣减的六位小数出借份额最小单位数量。
Six-decimal supply share base units debited by this withdrawal.

fields.name: amount_out_raw
docs: 实际转回钱包的借款代币最小单位数量。
Debt token base units actually sent back to the wallet.

fields.name: remaining_shares_raw
docs: 取回后该签名人仍持有的六位小数出借份额最小单位数量。
Six-decimal supply share base units held by the signer after withdrawal.

types.name: MockCollateralPrice
docs: 由市场管理员写入的测试价格，价格比较在链上执行。
Test price written by the market administrator and checked on-chain.

fields.name: market
docs: 此预言机所属的市场公钥。
Public key of the market that owns this oracle.

fields.name: price_raw
docs: 1 整单位抵押品对应的六位小数借款 Mint 最小单位数。
Debt mint base units per whole unit of collateral, using the six-decimal debt mint.

fields.name: published_at
docs: 链上 Clock 给出的价格发布时间，以 Unix 秒记录。
Publication time in Unix seconds from the on-chain Clock.

types.name: SupplyPool
docs: 单一市场出借的资产与总份额，独立记账以沿用初始化时的市场布局。
Supplied assets and total shares of one market, stored separately to preserve the initialized market layout.

fields.name: market
docs: 所属借贷市场的 PDA 公钥。
Public key of the lending market PDA.

fields.name: accounted_assets_raw
docs: 通过出借指令确认的借款资产，以六位小数的借款 Mint 最小单位记账。
Debt assets recognized by the supply instruction in base units of the six-decimal debt mint.

fields.name: total_shares_raw
docs: 全部钱包出借份额合计，以六位小数份额最小单位计。
Total shares across all suppliers, in six-decimal share base units.

types.name: SupplyPosition
docs: 指定市场与出借人的非转让份额记录。
Nontransferable share record for a market and supplier pair.

fields.name: market
docs: 此仓位所属市场的 PDA 公钥。
Public key of the market PDA for this position.

fields.name: supplier
docs: 发起出借、拥有份额的签名钱包公钥。
Public key of the signing wallet that supplies assets and owns the shares.

fields.name: shares_raw
docs: 该签名钱包持有的六位小数出借份额最小单位数。
Wallet shares in six-decimal base units.
